import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INV = 570000004;
    static final double EPSILON = 0.00001;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] p = new int[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (int) ((p[i][j] * INV) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = n; j < 6; j++) {
                if (i == j) p[i][j] = 1;
                else p[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        n = 6;

        int[] aah = new int[6];
        int t = 0;
        do {
            if (aah[0] < aah[1] && aah[1] < aah[2] && aah[3] < aah[4] && aah[4] < aah[5]) {
                int[] permsA = new int[3];
                int[] permsB = new int[3];
                permsA[0] = aah[0];
                permsA[1] = aah[1];
                permsA[2] = aah[2];
                permsB[0] = aah[3];
                permsB[1] = aah[4];
                permsB[2] = aah[5];
                for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                    int[] temp = permsA.clone();
                    int[] temp2 = permsB.clone();
                    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                        int val = temp[j];
                        int loc = val * 3 + j;
                        temp[j] = (int) (Math.log(loc) / Math.log(2));
                        temp2[j] = (int) (Math.log(loc + 3) / Math.log(2));
                    }
                    int bm1 = 0;
                    int bm2 = 0;
                    for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                        if ((1 << j) == temp[j]) bm1 |= (1 << j);
                        if ((1 << j) == temp2[j]) bm2 |= (1 << j);
                    }
                    if (bm1 != 0) {
                        permsA = temp;
                        permsB = temp2;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                t++;
            }
        } while (nextPermutation(aah));

        long[] bmA = new long[1 << 20];
        long[] bmB = new long[1 << 20];
        long[] f = new long[1 << 20];

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            long prob1 = 1;
            long prob2 = 1;
            int bm1 = 0;
            int bm2 = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                    int res = j * 3 + k;
                    if ((1 << res) == i) {
                        prob1 *= p[j][k];
                        prob2 *= p[j][k + 3];
                    } else {
                        prob1 *= (1 + MOD - p[j][k]);
                        prob2 *= (1 + MOD - p[j][k + 3]);
                    }
                    prob1 %= MOD;
                    prob2 %= MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int ot = 0; ot < 20; ot++) {
                int[] ord = new int[3];
                boolean ok = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok2 = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                        int val = permsA[ot][ord[j]];
                        int loc = val * 3 + j;
                        if ((1 << loc) != (1 << ot)) {
                            ok2 = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok2) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(ord));
                if (ok) {
                    bm1 |= (1 << ot);
                }
            }
            for (int ot = 0; ot < 20; ot++) {
                int[] ord = new int[3];
                boolean ok = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok2 = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                        int val = permsB[ot][ord[j]];
                        int loc = val * 3 + j;
                        if ((1 << loc) != (1 << ot)) {
                            ok2 = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok2) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(ord));
                if (ok) {
                    bm2 |= (1 << ot);
                }
            }
            bmA[bm1] = (bmA[bm1] + prob1) % MOD;
            bmB[bm2] = (bmB[bm2] + prob2) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            f[i] = bmA[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); mask++) {

    }

    public static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int n = array.length;
        int i = n - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i + 1] <= array[i]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i >= 0) {
            int j = n - 1;
            while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
                j--;
            }
            swap(array, i, j);
        }
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = n - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            swap(array, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void swap(int[] array, int i, int j) {
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }
}
